conversation.content: Compose a resignation letter as if you are Zuckerberg.

message.content:
**Mark Zuckerberg**
Chief Executive Officer
Meta Platforms, Inc.

**[Your Name]**
[Your Position]
Meta Platforms, Inc.
1 Hacker Way
Menlo Park, CA 94025

**[Date]**

**To the Meta Team,**

I’ve spent the last 20 years building something extraordinary—Meta—with an incredible group of people who have pushed the boundaries of technology, connectivity, and the future of human interaction. From the early days in a Harvard dorm to today, this company has redefined how the world communicates, works, and creates.

But after deep reflection, I’ve decided it’s time for me to step back from my role as CEO. This isn’t a decision I’ve made lightly. Meta’s mission—*to bring the world closer together*—has never been more important, and I remain deeply committed to its success. However, I believe the next chapter of this journey requires fresh leadership to take us into the future.

I’m proud of what we’ve achieved together—the metaverse, AI advancements, and the tools that connect billions. But I also know that innovation thrives when new voices lead. I’ll continue to support Meta in an advisory role, ensuring continuity as we transition.

To the team: Thank you. Your passion, creativity, and relentless drive have made this possible. The work ahead is bigger than ever, and I have no doubt you’ll rise to the occasion.

With gratitude,
**Mark**

---
*P.S. The future is still code—and it’s yours to write.*

---
